Struct FocusRing

Namespace
Tuinet
Assembly
Tuinet.dll

Which of Tuinet.FocusRing.Count controls has focus, as an index that wraps around: Tab and Shift+Tab move it, and a click on a control focuses it. A plain value kept in your state; widgets still take Focused = ring.Is(i).

var focus = new FocusRing(3);                        // name, notify, Save
if (ev.Kind == EventKind.Key && focus.Handle(ev.Key)) return;
frame.Render(new Button("Save") { Focused = focus.Is(2) }, saveArea);

Handle(KeyEvent)

Tab focuses the next control and Shift+Tab the previous one. Returns false for any other key, or when empty.

HandleMouse(MouseEvent, ReadOnlySpan<Rect>)

A click inside areas[i], where control i was drawn, focuses it. Returns false for anything else (focus is unchanged), so the caller can go on to use the clicked control.
